thread:
alex: Quick idea — can console have a "simulate traffic" flow that runs a shadow/replay with cost estimation before we flip any config?
kim: yes please. current 'dry-run' is too vague. we need per-route cost + perf impact and a safety throttle.
dia: agree. key constraints: 1) no doubling of user-visible traffic 2) scrub PII 3) ability to exclude regions/tenants.
alex: proposal: two modes — 'sampled-mirror' (send copies to runner) and 'modelled-cost' (estimate using perf profiles). show both in UI.
jorge: implementation sketch:
```
POST /internal/config/simulate
{
  "config_id": "route_tiers_v3",
  "mode": "sampled-mirror",    // or "modelled-cost"
  "sample_pct": 2,
  "window_mins": 60,
  "exclude_regions": ["eu-west-1"]
}
```
kim: For sampled-mirror we should enforce backend rate caps and auto-fail if observed backend saturation > 0.5. ops-bot: add runbook check.
ops-bot: runbook snippet: "If replay runner reports backend_saturation > 0.5 -> pause simulation, notify #eng-oncall, mark result as inconclusive."
dia: Telemetry: emit a single artifact 'simulation_summary' with tags: config_id, mode, sample_pct, p50_p95_latency_delta_ms, error_rate_delta_ppm, token_cost_delta_usd. send to 'config-sim' topic for dashboards.
alex: Dashboard UX: small sparkline of latency, a traffic breakdown by route, and a CI-style pass/fail with reasons. include estimated monthly cost delta extrapolated from sample.
jorge: Safety gate idea: add an opt-in 'tenant-consent' flag for GDPR regions — simulators won't mirror users unless tenant has consent. otherwise use modelled-cost.
kim: Metric contract: simulation_summary must include confidence_interval_low/high and sample_count. we need to avoid overinterpreting tiny samples.
dia: For rollout automation, allow a predicate like: "allow_rollout_if(simulation.p95_delta_ms < 15 && simulation.error_rate_delta_ppm < 200 && simulation.cost_delta_pct < 10)". expose that in the API.
alex: ownership: I'll do the console button + basic client. @jorge can you own the runner service and rate-limits?
jorge: yep, taking runner ownership. will add saturation probes and region-exclude logic.
kim: i'll wire telemetry and dashboards and add a small explainer in the docs.
dia: i'll write privacy checklist for replay payloads and help define scrub rules.
ops-bot: reminder: log all simulation requests to the audit log with initiator and timestamp.
alex: ok I'll open a PR for console mock and API contract later today. if anyone has blocking compliance concerns call them out now.
jorge: noted — will loop in legal for GDPR consent wording.
kim: moving mock to #product-design after lunch. :white_check_mark:
